nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the post-session L3 reflection write path: loads the session transcript, picks an LLM provider gated by the account/model blacklist, extracts behavioral insights, hash-dedups against existing learnings, and appends new ones as pending rows.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs as a fire-and-forget tokio::spawn from AgentSessionManager; owns the sole DB write site for this pipeline (semantic dedup/promotion happens later in a sibling `consolidation` module).

nodes.name: provider.rs
nodes.summary: Selects the LLM provider and model/account pair reused for reflection calls, returning None (a normal skip, not an error) when the session has no LLM binding or the account/model pair is blacklisted.

nodes.name: transcript.rs
nodes.summary: Builds the tail-biased user/assistant transcript text fed to the reflection LLM call, excluding tool turns and capping total size so insights about how the session concluded are preserved over older history.

nodes.name: activation.rs
nodes.summary: Implements session-scoped, path-triggered activation of conditional policies: augments tool-read results with matching always-context or path-conditional policy text while enforcing byte budgets and de-duplicating already-activated policies.

nodes.name: builtin.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the built-in skills (create-skill, create-rule, create-orgii-agent) whose SKILL.md content is compiled into the binary via include_str!, used as a fallback when neither the workspace nor global skill directories provide a match.

nodes.name: bundled_files.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri commands for batch reading and writing a skill's bundled non-markdown files (scripts, templates, assets) with path traversal validation against the skill directory.

nodes.name: commands.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command surface for the skills CRUD lifecycle: listing with per-agent disabled-state overlay, reading, toggling, name/frontmatter validation, creation, update, and moving a skill between personal/global/workspace scope.

nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Small shared utilities for the skills loader: token estimation for prompt budgeting, recursive bundled-file collection, skill directory resolution by scope, and relative-path traversal validation.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the skills loader: declares the bundled_files, commands, helpers, scanner, skill_env_storage, source_dirs, and types submodules and flat re-exports the Tauri command surface so `generate_handler!` can resolve them at the `loader::` path.
nodes.languageNotes: Re-exports both the command functions and their auto-generated `__cmd__*` siblings because Tauri's handler macro resolves commands relative to the declaring module path.

nodes.name: maybe_reflect_on_session
nodes.summary: Attempts post-session reflection: loads the transcript, resolves a non-blacklisted LLM provider, extracts insights, hash-dedups against existing learnings (reinforcing exact-content hits), and inserts new ones as pending. Returns Ok(0) on any soft-skip condition.

nodes.name: get_reflection_provider
nodes.summary: Resolves the (LLMProvider, account_id) pair to reuse for a reflection call, returning Ok(None) when the session has no LLM binding or the (account, model) pair is currently blacklisted.

nodes.name: build_transcript
nodes.summary: Loads user/assistant message rows for a session and renders them into a single tail-biased transcript string capped in size for the reflection LLM call.

nodes.name: append_transcript_line
nodes.summary: Appends one role-prefixed line to the transcript buffer, skipping empty content.

nodes.name: trim_head_to_cap
nodes.summary: Trims a transcript string down to a byte cap by dropping the oldest (head) content and keeping the tail, respecting UTF-8 character boundaries.

nodes.name: from_policy_set
nodes.summary: Constructs a SessionScopedContextActivator from a compiled PolicySet and the workspace root used to relativize matched paths.

nodes.name: augment_for_read_paths
nodes.summary: Given a batch of read paths, finds not-yet-activated conditional policies whose glob patterns match, appends their text (capped) to the tool result, and marks them activated for the rest of the session.

nodes.name: relative_path_for
nodes.summary: Converts an absolute path into a workspace-relative path string used for policy glob matching, falling back to the raw path when it isn't inside the workspace root.

nodes.name: cap_text_utf8
nodes.summary: Truncates text to a maximum byte length without splitting a multi-byte UTF-8 character.

nodes.name: SessionScopedContextActivator
nodes.summary: Tracks which conditional policies have already been activated within a session and applies path-triggered policy text to tool-read results, enforcing a total activated-policy byte budget.

nodes.name: list_builtin_skills
nodes.summary: Returns SkillInfo entries for every built-in skill, marking each as always-available and pre-computing its token estimate.

nodes.name: load_builtin_skill
nodes.summary: Looks up a built-in skill's raw content by name.

nodes.name: BuiltinSkill
nodes.summary: Descriptor for a built-in skill embedded in the binary: its name, one-line description, and full SKILL.md content.

nodes.name: skills_read_files_batch
nodes.summary: Tauri command that reads a batch of a skill's bundled files by relative path, returning per-file content or error without failing the whole batch on one bad path.

nodes.name: skills_write_files_batch
nodes.summary: Tauri command that writes a batch of bundled files into a skill directory, validating each relative path against traversal before writing and reporting per-file success/failure.

nodes.name: BundledFileContent
nodes.summary: Result entry for a batch bundled-file read: the relative path, its content (if readable), and an error string on failure.

nodes.name: BundledFileWriteResult
nodes.summary: Result entry for a batch bundled-file write: the relative path, success flag, and error string on failure.

nodes.name: load_disabled_skills_for
nodes.summary: Loads the set of skill names disabled for a given agent from the definitions store.

nodes.name: toggle_disabled_skill_for
nodes.summary: Adds or removes a skill name from an agent's disabled-skills set and persists the updated overrides.

nodes.name: loader_for_workspace
nodes.summary: Builds a SkillsLoader pre-configured with the global builtin directory and the workspace's extra source directories.

nodes.name: append_embedded_builtin_skills
nodes.summary: Appends built-in skill entries to a listing, skipping any name already present from workspace/global scans.

nodes.name: list_skills_with_config
nodes.summary: Assembles the full skill listing for a workspace by scanning source dirs and layering in built-in skills.

nodes.name: skills_list
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the per-agent skill listing (name, source, description, availability) with disabled-state applied.

nodes.name: skills_read
nodes.summary: Tauri command that reads a single skill's full metadata and content by name.

nodes.name: skills_toggle
nodes.summary: Tauri command that enables or disables a skill for an agent, persisting the change and invalidating the scanner cache.

nodes.name: skills_validate_name
nodes.summary: Tauri command that validates a proposed skill name for format correctness and collision with an existing skill.

nodes.name: validate_skill_name
nodes.summary: Checks a skill name against the allowed character set and length constraints.

nodes.name: validate_frontmatter_fields
nodes.summary: Validates the required and optional YAML frontmatter fields of a skill before it is created or updated.

nodes.name: skills_create
nodes.summary: Tauri command that creates a new skill directory with a SKILL.md assembled from frontmatter and body, in the requested scope.

nodes.name: skills_update
nodes.summary: Tauri command that overwrites an existing skill's frontmatter and body content.

nodes.name: skills_move
nodes.summary: Tauri command that moves a skill between personal/global/workspace scope, copying its directory to the new location and removing the old one.

nodes.name: copy_dir_recursive
nodes.summary: Recursively copies a directory tree, used to relocate a skill's bundled files during a scope move.

nodes.name: collect_bundled_files
nodes.summary: Lists the non-SKILL.md files bundled alongside a skill directory.

nodes.name: collect_bundled_files_recursive
nodes.summary: Recursive helper that walks a skill directory collecting bundled file paths relative to the skill root.

nodes.name: resolve_skill_dir
nodes.summary: Resolves the on-disk directory for a named skill by scope (workspace vs global/personal).

nodes.name: validate_relative_path
nodes.summary: Rejects relative paths that attempt directory traversal (`..`) or are absolute, used to guard bundled-file read/write operations.
